regime_context: In China A-shares, the detector shows AI Compute & Optics as the leading theme with a durable trend but low breadth (0.235). Rotation is narrowing, with Semiconductors close behind. The absolute trend gate has not reduced drawdown historically in this market (gate_helps=false), and cross-sectional momentum rank offers no validated return forecast. The macro backdrop is dominated by AI/tech narratives, but all recent news flow is unscheduled (surprise-driven). Overall, the detector's signal is experimental here; any leans should be held with high humility.
emerging_watch: Semiconductors as a potential challenger: if its score surpasses AI Compute & Optics and its breadth remains above 0.3, a handoff could be confirmed. Kill criterion: gap widens >0.15 in favor of AI Compute & Optics or Semiconductors breadth drops below 0.2.

theses.subject: AI Compute & Optics
theses.thesis: The theme exhibits trend health (hurst=trend, durability 0.52), eligibility due to positive absolute trend, and lacks crowding. While breadth is only 0.235, the theme's leadership and trend continuation suggest it may outperform in a rising market, contingent on breadth improvement. The detector's absolute trend gate is unreliable in this market, so this is a low-conviction view.
theses.dissent: The low breadth (only 23.5% of constituents participating) indicates fragile leadership; the trend could reverse sharply if a narrow group of stocks loses momentum. The gate's historical failure in this market undermines confidence in trend persistence.

falsifier.text: Theme drops from eligibility (absolute trend gate turns false) or breadth falls below 0.15.

falsifier.text: Breadth drops below 0.8 or the theme becomes ineligible for more than 3 consecutive days.
